title: Agent Harness Profile 0.1 approval decision
description: A human decision on one approval request. Valid only if: the request is pending, decided_by is a human principal listed in the request's routing.approvers and not an agent, decided_at is before the request's expires_at, and enforced_identity equals the request's arguments_digest. At most one decision per request. Requirement levels in property descriptions follow the profile: Required, Conditionally Required, Recommended, Opt-In.

$schema.description: Opt-In. URI of this JSON Schema. When present it MUST be exactly this schema's $id.

request_id.description: Required. id of the approval request being decided.

decided_by.description: Required. Principal id of the human who decided. MUST NOT be an agent principal.

decided_at.description: Required. RFC 3339 date-time of the decision.

enforced_identity.description: Required. Lowercase hex SHA-256 of JCS(arguments) that the human saw and approved. MUST equal the request's arguments_digest; otherwise the decision is invalid and the call is denied.

scope.description: Required. What the decision covers. Only once (this single call) is defined in 0.1.

channel.description: Required. Channel through which the decision was made.

reason.description: Opt-In. Short reason given by the human. Treat as personal data in audit records (store a keyed hash and a reference, not the text).

decided_by_dispatcher.description: Required. True if and only if decided_by is the request's dispatcher.
